description: This file contains platform-specific functions for OpenWrt firmware management, including image verification, upgrade, and configuration copying procedures for various hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the provided image is valid for the specific hardware based on the board type and root device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the firmware upgrade process based on the hardware board and storage medium.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to the new root filesystem depending on the hardware storage method.
